content.short: Bulletproofs provides concise zero-knowledge proofs without a trusted setup.
content.description: Bulletproofs are a zero-knowledge argument of knowledge that proves a secret lies within a specified range. The proofs are succinct, non-interactive, and require no trusted setup, making them practical for validating commitments in Confidential Transactions. They distinguish themselves by combining multiple range proofs into a single, concise proof, delivering efficiency while maintaining security. Verification is longer than that of zk-SNARKs, but the method does not rely on a trusted setup, offering a compact and reliable range-proof system.
